properties.name: Barrier lake (Chhochen Khola - Purepu Tsangpo confluence)
properties.description: China MWR via CCTV/Global Times (27 Aug): lake volume about 2 million cubic metres, already overflowing, with another 3 million cubic metres expected within three days and a high breach risk. Location approximate; the same Purepu glacier system produced the 8 July 2025 GLOF.

properties.name: Gyirong Port damage cluster, Tibet
properties.description: Reuters-cited reporting: at least six major hydropower plants and infrastructure at the Gyirong Port trade hub damaged in the multi-stage hazard chain before the flood reached Nepal.
